MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #12
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Reproduction? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Reproduction.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Reproduction.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Reproduction.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Reproduction.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Technologies and Innovations in aquaculture? (1 mark)

   D. Ice melting to water

6. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

7. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Record keeping in aquaculture? (1 mark)

   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

13. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)

   A. Decomposers only
   B. Tertiary consumers
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Ecology and Ecosystems? (1 mark)

   A. Heating until a solid melts
